rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The dismal swamp suddenly erupts in a cacophony of noise as a flock of
hawk-billed birds swoop from a nearby tree, disturbed by your passing.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc: You trudge through waist-deep muck in a black, forbidding swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc: Drops of rain splatter into the swamp around you.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The inky blackness of the swamp waters hides whatever it is that keeps
nibbling on your boots. The darkness around you is still and complete.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The swamp stretches out in all directions, each as unappealing as its
neighbor.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A giant igauna, its scales glinting off of the meager sunlight, reminds
you momentarily of its great ancestor the dragon, hoarding its treasure
somewhere not quite as uncomfortable as this swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
Your entire body seems to be inundated with the grainy slime of the swamp.
You crave a warm bed and cold bottle of ale.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
To the east you spy a crudely carved stone obelisk. The swamp stretches
in all directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A small stone totem pole sticks out of the damp ground. You can make
out runes of healing engraved into it's surface. This seems to be a good,
if not safe, place to rest.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
Petrified trunks of ironwood, hard as stone, block your way south and 
west.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The swamp seems alive with life, but all of it hides, as though afraid
of you, or more likely, silently stalking you.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The sun seems to struggle to push its light this far; the very air
around you absorbs the heat of the meager rays.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The swamp is almost still here; water striders the size of your fist
glide effortlessly across the mirror-like surface of the black water.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc: Black sludge slurps at your boots as you trudge onward.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
Raucous cries of swamp birds fill your ears, but you can't see anything
in the trees around you.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
Something under the murk of the swamp slithers between your boots. You
hope it doesn't have any bigger siblings.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A small corpse hangs from a noose tied high in a tree here. It looks very
old, and judging by the stature, it could be dwarven. You wonder why someone
was hanged here - or perhaps he hanged himself?

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A sudden current of water and sludge sucks you under, but you manage
to surface, disoriented and half-drowned.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
Petrified tree trunks are packed so close that travel east or west is
impossible. The natural "alley" created by the formations leads you north
and south.

rooms.name: A Dead End in the Swamp
rooms.desc:
Thick scrub and intertwined tree limbs bar all further progression.
The only path is back south.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A lone totem pole stand barely above the murk of the swamp here. It
seems to radiate an inner light.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The waters are very peaceful here, and you feel a strange electricity
in the air to the west.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A flurry of movement out of the corner of your eyes causes you to glance down,
and you see a mass of lizards, slithering over each other in a frenzy. The
living ball slowly sinks in the murk of swamp...

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The black waters of the swamp tug at your spirit almost as hard as it tugs
at your boots; sucking you lower in the quagmire.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
Rotting peat and other vegetation creates an overwhelming odor here.
Noxious swamp gases fill your nostrils and burn your eyes. You hurry
onward.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
Petrified tree trunks jut out of the ankle-deep muck that clings to
your boots. The murky waters of the swamp swirl deeper to the east.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The muddy swamp water rises to knee depth here, and seems even higher
to the south. To the west your prodding reveals higher ground.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A steady current stirs the water, pulling it slowly south. Bits of
debris and rotting vegetation float by.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc: You are travelling through the murky waters of the Swamp of Sadness.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A ball of fire ants, clinging together and floating along on a living
raft made of their peers, floats by you. You keep a sharp eye out for
other such tiny hazards that could make your days of adventuring much
shorter.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The water is pretty deep here; almost up to your waist. It's still dark
and murky though, and something beneath the surface keeps bumping against
your inner thigh.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A slurping sound alerts you to an opening beneath the surface of the
water.  A small vortex of swamp muck sweeps sluggishly down a crack in
the ground beneath your feet. It seems much to narrow for you to traverse, 
but looks none-too-appealing even if you could.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The swamp seems to pulse with a life of it's own as you struggle to
find an escape.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A sudden current of water sweeps you off your feet, carrying you
under the putrid swamp. You fight to the surface, gagging, weary,
and disoriented.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc: You are travelling through the murky waters of the Swamp of Sadness.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A petrified tree trunk snags on your boot just beneath the surface of
the swamp. You fall to one knee, cursing the desire that brought you into
this accursed place.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The swamp is impassable in all directions but west here; petrified trees
stand at strange angles to the swamp floor, barring your way and blocking out 
the meager light of the sun far above.

rooms.desc: The bleak waters of the swamp glow softly here with foxfire.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
Your path ends here, cut off by a tangle of thorny swamp scrub so dense
even your brazen will can not pass.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
Natural formations of petrified tree trunks bar your way to the north
and south. You long to be out of these accursed mazes of dank swampland.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
You hear swiftly running water to the southeast. In all visible
directions the stagnant swamp seems to mock you.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
East of here a large trunk of tree, long since petrified into stone,
blocks your path.  Creepers of vine and dead foliage drape down from the
dark covering of the swamp trees that grow above you.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A snake as long as you are tall slithers quickly by, leaving barely a
ripple in the glassy black waters.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A pocket of air escapes from the peat beneath the water's surface,
shaken loose by your footstep. Mud splatters your face, adding to your
ire.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A jagged tree trunk, about waist high, stands alone here. Carved into its
trunk is the date: 09-28-96.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
You hear the splashing of a two-legged being walking the swamp to the
southeast. Around you the waters of the swamp ripple with hidden life.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The stumps of petrified ironwood trees stick out of the swamp like
skeletal fingers. Every shadow seems to be alive, and nowhere seems
to lead to an exit from this unending murk.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
You trudge through waist-deep muck. A small waterfall has been created
here where the waters of the swamp pour down a narrow opening in the swamp
floor.
